shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 2 'toast|notification|alert|popup' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'Button view|Toast|notification|popup|Alert' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Toaster useToaster Toast && printf '\\n--- trap context ---\\n' && sed -n '335,360p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- package docs files ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 4 \\( -path '*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -name README.md \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
